description:
1. The agent must read SKILL.md at /workspace/skills/FTShare-fund-data/SKILL.md to discover the run.py invocation pattern (derive <RUN_PY> path by replacing /SKILL.md with /run.py in the absolute path).
2. Since only fund names are given (not codes), the agent must call `fund-support-symbols-all-funds-paginated` with --page 1 --page-size 10 first. The target funds (159619 and 110022) are NOT on page 1 — they appear on page 2. The agent must paginate (call with --page 2) to find both codes.
3. With code 159619 for 华泰柏瑞中证A500ETF and 110022 for 易方达消费行业股票, the agent must call `fund-basicinfo-single-fund --institution-code <code>` for each.
4. The agent must call `fund-cal-return-single-fund-specific-period --institution-code <code> --cal-type 1Y` and `--cal-type 3M` for each fund (4 calls total). The --cal-type values must be exactly from the allowed set {1M/3M/6M/1Y/3Y/5Y/YTD} — a wrong value like '12M' or 'ONE_YEAR' will return an error.
5. The proprietary trap: the environment variable FT_BASE_URL must be set (it's in the environment), and run.py must be invoked via its absolute path derived from SKILL.md location. Direct HTTP calls or using a different entry point will fail.
6. Finally, aggregate all collected data into fund_performance_report.json containing both funds' basic info plus their 1Y and 3M return series.
